title: Two polymeric 36-metal pure lanthanide nanosize clusters

material_class.structural_family: Square-layer coordination polymer assembled from Gd36 cluster units

synthesis.procedure: Sodium azide was added to an aqueous solution of nicotinic acid and GdCl3·6H2O. Nitric acid was then added in a fume hood. The mixture was sealed in a Teflon-lined bomb, heated at 180 °C for three days, and slowly cooled to obtain colorless prism crystals. The Markdown renders the nicotinic-acid mass as 0.49 mg for 0.4 mmol and leaves the nitric-acid volume unit and cooling rate uncertain.

reagents.name: nicotinic acid
reagents.amount: 0.4 mmol (mass rendered as 0.49 mg in Markdown; inconsistent with the stated amount in mmol)

reagents.name: nitric acid
reagents.amount: 100, volume unit unclear in Markdown; 2 mol L−1

synthesis.ph: 4.61 after acid addition; 4.91 for the obtained crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling afforded colorless prism crystals; the cooling rate is illegible in the supplied Markdown.

properties.summary: The susceptibility data suggest dominant antiferromagnetic interactions. Compound 1 exhibits a large magnetocaloric effect; entropy changes derived from heat-capacity and magnetization data agree.

measurements.name: Curie–Weiss θ

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Gd36 unit is a compressed, sphere-like assembly of a cyclohexane-chair-like Gd24 wheel and two tripod-like Gd6 units. Six Gd4 subunits form the wheel; nicotinate carboxylate coordination links the cluster units into a two-dimensional square layer.
